name: opspilot-ai
description: OpsPilot AI full-stack operations intelligence platform

scripts.install:all: npm ci && npm --prefix server ci && npm --prefix client ci
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n ML,RISK,API,WEB -c magenta,yellow,cyan,green ".venv/Scripts/python.exe -m uvicorn ml.resolution_api:app --reload --port 8000" ".venv-delayrisk/Scripts/python.exe -m uvicorn ml.delay_risk_service:app --reload --port 8001" "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n ML,API,WEB -c magenta,cyan,green "venv\Scripts\python.exe -m uvicorn ml.resolution_api:app --reload --port 8000" "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix client run build
